about_the_game:
Magnet Fishing Simulator is a simulation-adventure game where players explore diverse aquatic biomes and retrieve submerged metal objects using magnetic fishing tools. Every item you recover can be cleaned, repaired, and sold for profit—or added to your growing collection of rare finds. The game combines exploration, renovation, and progression, letting you unlock better equipment and access to more challenging and rewarding locations.

Gameplay Features

🧲 Explore and Salvage

  • Use a variety of magnets to fish metal objects out of rivers, lakes, oceans, and even a sunken city.

  • Stronger magnets allow you to retrieve heavier and more valuable items.

  • Upgrade to a boat or diving suit to access deeper areas and hand-pick treasures from the seabed.

🔧 Restore and Profit

  • Bring salvaged items back to your hub, where you can:

    • Remove rust with specialized tools

    • Repair broken parts or missing components

    • Clean and polish items to restore their original appearance

  • Choose to sell items for profit or keep them in your collection for bonuses and achievements.

🏆 Collect and Display

  • Build themed collections (e.g., antique weapons, vintage coins, sunken timepieces).

  • Completing collections boosts sale prices and unlocks special rewards.

  • Display collections in a museum to earn passive income and show off your finds.

📈 Progression and Upgrades

  • Upgrade your magnets to handle heavier, more complex objects.

  • Purchase boats for deeper water travel and diving suits for manual underwater exploration.

  • Invest in advanced restoration tools to clean and repair faster and more efficiently.

World & Exploration

🌍Diverse Biomes to Discover:

  • River – Starting location, basic items and easy exploration.

  • Lake – Submerged boats and chests, medium difficulty.

  • Seaport – Rich in scrap and rare artifacts.

  • Sunken City – Abandoned ruins hiding historic treasures; requires diving.

  • Ocean Depths – Challenging and remote, filled with rare, high-value items.

🗺️Interactive Map System:

  • The in-game map is accessible from your hub, letting you select locations and view details about potential finds and equipment requirements.

  • Some areas require fuel (for boat travel) or specific gear (like a diving suit).

  • As you progress, new locations unlock based on your equipment and total items recovered.
